title: The Friday Brief · 21 Aug 2026
standfirst: A light Friday: one hard push before noon, then two reviews and an early close. Two chases are overdue — see Owed to you.

push.title: Sign the Q3 scope change before standup
push.body: The devs are blocked on the signed scope for the [Q3 landing page epic](https://your-jira.atlassian.net/browse/EX-114). It was drafted Tuesday; ten minutes with the PDF unblocks a team of five. Sign, upload to Drive, tag the epic.
push.seed:
I need to sign the Q3 scope change for the landing page epic and get it back to the team.

Where to look: EX-114 in Jira (the epic), the PDF 'Q3 Landing Page Scope v3' in Google Drive shared by Dana on 18 Aug, #eng-landing in Slack.

Done looks like: the signed PDF uploaded back to the same Drive folder, the epic updated with the link, and a message in #eng-landing telling the team it is signed. You can reach Jira, Google Drive, Slack, and the web.
push.feedback_hint: Wrong call? Different owner? Say so and I will redo the hand-off.
